description.value: Big Bite Donair has been a fixture of the Lynn Valley community since 2016, serving authentic Middle Eastern and Mediterranean fare — kababs over open flame, homemade sauces, shawarma, falafel, and rich Afghan rice dishes. It is primarily a takeout operation with very limited seating, and the owner is widely praised by customers for personal attention and food quality. The restaurant also accepts Bitcoin Lightning payments, an unusual feature for a small neighbourhood eatery.

address.value: 1252 Lynn Valley Road, North Vancouver, V7J 2A3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Bite Donair is an active Mediterranean/Middle Eastern restaurant in Lynn Valley, North Vancouver, operating since 2016, with online ordering and a full menu page. A customer review explicitly states 'It is more of a take out place, however there is one table with two chairs,' confirming it primarily serves takeout. The website prominently advertises vegetarian and vegan options (falafel, bolani) and includes a specific note for vegans; no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging is present anywhere on the site.
